name: POST /api/voice-agent/calls/:call_id/live-ticket - Ticket for the live transcript WebSocket
description: Mints a single-use ticket (valid 60 s, bound to this call and the caller) that opens WS /api/voice-agent/calls/:call_id/live?ticket=... — browsers cannot send a bearer header on a WebSocket and a JWT in the URL would be written to proxy logs, so authorization happens here, under the JWT (381767f5-a64c-4c63-9918-9feab02424ec#AC3 — an authorized user receives live turns for a call over WebSocket and an unauthorized user is refused). Authorized viewers: the call's owner (its requester or the agent's acting persona), a persona with a ReBAC edge of kind VOICE_LIVE_REBAC_KIND (default "supervises") to an owner, or an API key holding voice-agent.call.read; another tenant's call reads as 404 and anyone else in the tenant is refused 403. Only a sha256 of the ticket is stored.

testCases.name: The call owner mints a live ticket

errorCases.message: not authorized to watch this call | API key lacks voice-agent.call.read
errorCases.when: same tenant but neither owner, supervisor nor a key with the read scope
unknown call or another tenant's call
